Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Kidney & Bladder Health
    Comprehensive kidney and bladder health covering urinary tract infections, bladder dysfunction, kidney stones, and related conditions affecting fluid balance and toxin removal.
  • Blood Sugar Imbalance
    Imbalances in blood sugar regulation, including hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
  • Thyroid Dysfunction
    Underactive or overactive thyroid gland leading to hormonal imbalance and metabolic issues.
  • Hair Loss
    Excessive hair loss due to nutritional deficiencies, hormonal imbalance, or autoimmune conditions.
  • Metabolic Syndrome
    Cluster of conditions including high blood pressure, high blood sugar, excess body fat around the waist, and abnormal cholesterol levels.
  • Neuropathy
    Nerve damage causing pain, tingling, and numbness, often in extremities.
